angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 480,033 km at 58.56 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.0766 +/- 0.0101 mas (same row, RUWE 1.08): 58.56 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.69 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 480,033 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.71 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4534 +/- 128 K from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1184 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1184.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.612, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1184: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1184 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.017 dex, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1184 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.70115, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1184 (pscomppars): age 5.3 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
